data.description:
## Description

What: Modify plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh to inject 'Session-Id: $CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID' and 'Generated-By: dso-merge-to-main-pr.sh' trailer lines at the end of the PR body at create time, with the session-id value shell-quote-sanitized before injection. Why: PRs without a session marker cause cross-session misclassification; the trailer is the foundation the ownership helper reads. Scope IN: trailer injection in both PR-creation paths (auto-merge mode and PR-only mode per fb32-215c); sanitization of the session-id value; a shell unit test asserting both trailer lines are present and that a synthetic newline-containing session ID is rejected at sanitization with a clear error. Scope OUT: the ownership-check helper (draft-3), the wrapper (draft-4).


## Done Definitions

- merge-to-main-pr.sh injects a 'Session-Id: <value>' and a 'Generated-By: dso-merge-to-main-pr.sh' trailer line at the end of the PR body in both PR-creation paths ← Satisfies: sc-1
- The session-id value is shell-quote-sanitized before injection, and a synthetic newline-containing session ID is rejected at sanitization with a clear, non-zero-exit error message ← Satisfies: sc-1
- A shell unit test asserts both trailer lines are present in a generated PR body and that the newline-rejection path produces the error and non-zero exit ← Satisfies: sc-1
- A shell unit test asserts that re-running the PR-body update path on an already-stamped PR does NOT add a second Session-Id trailer and does NOT overwrite the original value — the first-stamped Session-Id value is immutable across re-edits ← Satisfies: sc-1

## Considerations

- [Compat] fb32-215c: both PR creation paths (auto-merge mode and PR-only mode) must stamp the trailer — do not stamp only one path.
- [Truncation] Place trailers at end-of-body so GitHub's 65k truncation impact is detectable; coordinate the absent-vs-truncated boundary with the helper (draft-3).
- [Immutability] 70f6-05f1: Session-Id is immutable once stamped — do not re-stamp or overwrite on later edits.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO session, I want merge-to-main-pr.sh to stamp sanitized Session-Id and Generated-By trailers into the PR body at create, so that every DSO-created PR carries an ownership marker that survives cross-session resolution.
